lines: Dil hi to hai na sang-o-khisht, dard se bhar na aaye kyun?
couplets.en: It is only a heart, neither stone nor brick, so why should it not fill with pain?

lines: Dard se bhar na aaye kyun?
couplets.en: Why should the heart not fill with pain?

lines: Royenge hum hazaar baar, koi hamein sataaye kyun?
couplets.en: We will weep a thousand times, so why should anyone torment us?

lines: Qaid-e-hayaat o band-e-gham, asl mein dono ek hain.
couplets.en: The prison of life and the chains of sorrow are one and the same.

lines: Maut se pehle aadmi gham se nijaat paaye kyun?
couplets.en: Why should anyone be free of sorrow before death?

lines: Dil hi to hai na sang-o-khisht, dard se bhar na aaye kyun?

lines: Ghalib-e-khasta ke baghair, kaun se kaam band hain?
couplets.en: What comes to a standstill without poor Ghalib?

lines: Ghalib-e-khasta ke baghair, kaun se kaam band hain?
couplets.en: What comes to a standstill without poor Ghalib?

lines: Roiye zaar zaar kya, kijiye haaye haaye kyun?
couplets.en: Why weep so bitterly, why cry out in grief?
